title: Fluidd: 'Enable Full Display' switched on
note: Switches Fluidd's 'Enable Full Display' setting on (Settings > General). It is a Fluidd setting stored in Moonraker's database on the printer, so it applies in every browser; reload an open Fluidd page once. You can still change it in Fluidd's settings; the next install sets it back. Uninstall puts Fluidd's own default (off) back.
